question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the given group of words.

Natural talent for something
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"flair"** means a natural talent or aptitude for something. (प्राकृतिक प्रतिभा)

 
 
• Example**: **She has a ***flair** *for painting, producing beautiful artworks effortlessly.
 
• Example : She had a ***flair ***for languages
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word for a natural talent for something is **'flair'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Feeling **(भावना): An emotional state or reaction.

 
 
• **Example:** He had a ***feeling*** of relief after the exam was over.
 
 
 
• **Favour **(सुविधा): Approval, support, or liking for someone or something.
 
 
• **Example: **She did him a*** favour ***by lending him her car.
 
 
 
• **Flavour** (स्वाद): The distinctive taste of a food or drink.
 
 
• **Example:** The ice cream has a rich chocolate*** flavour.***
